name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's Educational Crisis Scholarship Support (ECSS) Programme 2026-27
provider: HDFC Bank Limited (CSR programme Parivartan; implemented by Buddy4Study)

rules.quote: The opportunity is open to school students from Classes 1 to 12, as well as those pursuing diploma, ITI, polytechnic, UG, and PG (both general and professional) courses.
The applicants must have passed the previous qualifying examination with at least 55% marks.
The annual family income must be less than or equal to INR 2.5 lakh.

rules.value: preference to students who faced personal/family crisis in past three years
rules.quote: Preference will be given to those applicants who have experienced personal or family crises that have occurred during the past three years

amount.text: Up to Rs 75,000 (slabs vary by level)
amount.quote: The programme aims to provide financial assistance of up to INR 75,000 to meritorious students with limited financial means.
amount.note: UG/PG slabs on the application pages not separately printed

documents.name: Government ID proof
documents.quote: Government-issued identity proof of the applicant

documents.name: Admission proof 2026-27
documents.quote: Current year admission proof for 2026-27 (Fee Receipt, Admission Letter, Institution ID Card, or Bonafide Certificate)

documents.name: Bank details
documents.quote: Bank account details (copy of passbook or cancelled cheque in the applicant's or parent's name)

documents.name: Income certificate or affidavit
documents.quote: Income Certificate issued by SDM, DM, CO, or Tehsildar

documents.name: Crisis proof if applicable
documents.quote: Proof of family or personal crisis (if applicable)

deadline.text: UG and PG application deadline 31 Oct 2026 (programme runs in rounds; FAQ still shows 2025 round dates)
